analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo reported revenue from continuing operations of Rs 12,623.06 lakhs for FY 2024-25, up from Rs 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24, while net profit decreased to Rs 809.85 lakhs primarily due to the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals business. The Scheme of Demerger for the Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited became effective on May 4, 2024, with trading of the resulting company's shares commencing in March 2025. The Board recommended a dividend of 10% (Rs 1 per share) for FY 2024-25, representing a total cash outflow of Rs 3,13,57,850. Management emphasized its commitment to ongoing R&D investments, adopting new technologies, and commercializing high-margin research-driven products. Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded a profit after tax of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company plans to venture into new markets with favorable competition and work on new, complex products as it enters fiscal 2024.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

guidance.claim: The company intends to leverage its R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and customer-centric products to reach new heights.
guidance.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that FY 2024-25 marked another milestone for the company, surpassing operational benchmarks set in the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: The financial year 2024-25 has marked another milestone for the Company, surpassing the operational benchmarks set in the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model around profitable revenue growth and high-margin research-based products for domestic and overseas customers.
demand_outlook.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's pan-India presence and expanding footprint in overseas markets have yielded rich dividends.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

capex_expansion.claim: The scheme of demerger for the company's Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business became effective from May 4, 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: The Scheme became effective from May 4, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: Trading of the equity shares of the resulting demerged company, Vikram Aroma Limited, commenced on March 6, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the trading approval was granted on March 4, 2025, and trading of its shares commenced on March 6, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Post-demerger, each entity will specialize in its core business and scale up independently by attracting targeted resources and investment.
capex_expansion.quote: Each company would specialize in their respective core business and independently scale up their businesses by attracting specific resources and investment to support their growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved a scheme of arrangement to demerge its Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred no capital expenditure on Research and Development during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: the expenditure incurred on Research and Development Capital Expenditure - Nil

capex_expansion.claim: The company's foreign exchange outgo for machinery was Rs. 187,919.00.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded revenue from continuing operations of Rs 12,623.06 lakhs and Profit After Tax of Rs 809.85 lakhs for FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: The Company recorded a revenue of Rs.12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operation and Rs.451.98 lakhs from discontinuing operation and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs.809.85 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Total income from continuing operations increased to Rs 12,623.06 lakhs in FY 2024-25 compared to Rs 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income from continuing operation increased to Rs. 12623.06 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 10127.26 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

margins_costs.claim: PAT decreased to Rs 809.85 lakhs in FY 2024-25 from Rs 2,537.87 lakhs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: PAT decreased to Rs. 809.85 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 2537.87 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the decrease in PAT was primarily driven by the demerger of a business unit.
margins_costs.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased to Rs. 2,537.87 Lakhs from Rs. 1,691.29 Lakhs in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT increased to Rs. 2537.87 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 1691.29 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: The revenue expenditure incurred on research and development was Rs. 16,07,578.44.
The company's revenue expenditure on Research and Development was Rs. 7,32,855.82.
The company's foreign exchange outgo for raw materials was Rs. 621,000.00.
The company's finance cost for the financial year 2022-23 was Rs. 116.94 lakhs.

capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount from profits to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company made no loans, guarantees, or investments under Section 186 during the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review there are no loans, guarantees or investments under section 186 made by the company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept any fixed deposits from the public under Sections 73 to 76 of the Companies Act, 2013.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Company has not accepted any fixed deposits from the public within the provisions of Section 73 to 76 of the Companies Act, 2013.

capital_allocation.claim: The total outflow for the recommended dividend payout will be Rs. 2,35,18,388.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs.1,56,78,925/- (Previous Year Rs.94,07,355/-).

capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has declared issue of bonus shares to the shareholders in the ratio of 4 Equity shares for every 1 equity shares held. The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review there were no loans, guarantees or investments under section 186 made by the company.

capital_allocation.quote: The paid up Equity Share Capital as on 31st March, 2023 was Rs. 313578500.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has implemented a Risk Management Policy to identify risks that could threaten its existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The risk management framework covers both internal and external risks, as well as readiness for extreme events like calamities and disasters.
risks_headwinds.quote: The process involves identifying both external and internal risks and the readiness to respond to extreme risks like calamities and disasters.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continuously identifies internal and external risks covering strategy, operations, legal compliance, financial reporting, and cyber security.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to ongoing investment in R&D, adopting emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth by developing and commercializing high-margin, research-driven products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to consistently investing in research and development and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue its transformation journey in fiscal 2024 by entering new markets and working on complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
